stock_movements_reason_required.name: stock_movements_reason_required
stock_movements_reason_required.value:
"stock_movements"."movement_type" not in ('ADJUSTMENT', 'LOSS')
          or ("stock_movements"."reason" is not null and length(btrim("stock_movements"."reason")) > 0)

stock_movements_adjustment_direction.name: stock_movements_adjustment_direction
stock_movements_adjustment_direction.value:
("stock_movements"."movement_type" = 'ADJUSTMENT'
            and "stock_movements"."adjustment_direction" in ('INCREASE', 'DECREASE'))
          or ("stock_movements"."movement_type" <> 'ADJUSTMENT' and "stock_movements"."adjustment_direction" is null)
